lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines. Spacing is widest at the anterior shoulder (approx. 60-80px) and progressively narrows toward the posterior haunch (approx. 30-40px).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 14th posterior line. A secondary minor split is observable in the upper-mid section of the 7th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 11, 12, and 13 terminate as dashed segments before reaching the ventral midline. Three isolated elliptical white blobs are located in the inter-line space between lines 10 and 11.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots located on the posterior-lateral haunch, with a higher density of 4 spots in the mid-haunch region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the lower posterior haunch align horizontally to form a 2-point linear vector parallel to the ventral plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small V-shaped notch visible on the upper-inner margin of the right pinna (ear).
other_distinctive_markers: White transverse chevron mark on the bridge of the muzzle and two distinct circular white spots on the lower mandible/cheek.
